<thought>Identify a retrosynthetic template that forms the C‑C bond of the stilbene by coupling an aryl iodide with a vinyl arene (Heck reaction). The target can be disconnected into 4‑iodoanisole (COc1ccc(I)cc1) and 4‑methoxystyrene (COc1ccc(C=C)cc1), both commercially available and inexpensive. Use a template that breaks a C‑I bond (6‑53) and forms a C‑C bond (6‑6).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "bonds_broken": ["6-53"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
